rules: Use tight letter spacing for large numbers (tracking-tight).
All financial figures (₹) MUST use IBM Plex Mono for tabular lining and clarity.
Headings use Cabinet Grotesk font-medium or font-semibold, never font-black unless for massive KPIs.
No full-screen gradients. Texture over gloss.
Use Semantic colors exclusively for financial states: Danger/Crimson for expenses, Success/Emerald for received funds/repayments.

visual_enhancers.shadows: None. Use 1px solid borders (border-zinc-200) to define hierarchy instead of shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: border-zinc-200 for containers, border-zinc-300 on hover.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px) to maintain a sharp, authoritative, accounting ledger feel.

layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (MODE B) with gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized.
layouts.spacing: Dense internally for tables (py-2, px-3), generous for section gaps (py-8, py-12).
layouts.alignment: All financial numbers MUST be right-aligned in tables. Labels left-aligned. Never center-align tabular data.

components.cards: Remove default shadcn rounded corners and shadows. Apply 1px border. Use rectangular, dense styles.
components.tables: Dense rows, 1px border bottoms, clear hover states (hover:bg-zinc-50). Strip alternating row colors, rely on 1px borders.
components.forms: Use Shadcn forms but strip out rounded corners. Inputs must have focus:ring-1 focus:ring-zinc-900 focus:border-zinc-900.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none), dark fill (bg-zinc-900), white text. Include subtle scale down on active: scale-95.
components.dropdowns: DO NOT use transparent backgrounds. Must have solid white/dark background with 1px border.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all rows and cards. Very fast transitions (duration-150 ease-out).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings required on all interactive elements.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='expense-submit-button').

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense, professional financial tools. lucide-react is also acceptable if Phosphor is unavailable.

images.description: Abstract architecture gray texture for the login page hero/split screen.

libraries.charts: Recharts (via Shadcn ui/charts) for Category Breakdown. Use minimal grid lines and high contrast semantic colors.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Left Sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Expenses, Staff Ledger, Tax Compliance).
Dashboard: Top-left 'North Star KPI' (Total Spend). Include cards for Petrol Cost, Total Staff Advances, Cash vs UPI ratio, and a Category Breakdown Chart.
Expense Logger: Create a fast-entry form. Category must be a Shadcn Combobox/Select with pre-defined defaults and a '+ Add Custom Category' action.
Staff Salary Ledger: Create a data-dense table with Columns: Employee Name, Base Salary, Month Advances (Sum), Net Payable. Include action to 'Add Advance'.
Tax Compliance: A dedicated table for GST and ITR Advance Tax with challan numbers.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for macro-layouts, Shadcn for micro-components (Tables, Forms).
Inject Cabinet Grotesk for Headings and IBM Plex Mono for all ₹ amounts.
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Never use Emojis.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Do not make generic centered layouts.
Create depth through 1px border layering, not shadows.
NEVER center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like sharp buttons with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use Shadcn calendar for date pickers (NOT HTML input type='date').
